shared_elements: elaborate headdress occupying the upper zone
circular disc or medallion ornament on the chest
bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
carved stone monument, taller than wide
paired small motifs flanking the central figure
justification: Both are vertical stone monuments dominated by a single frontal, symmetrical anthropomorphic figure whose headdress fills the top third and whose chest bears a prominent circular disc ornament, with smaller motifs flanking the body — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner of execution differs sharply, however: A is a massive rounded three-dimensional boulder in dark, coarse, heavily eroded stone with broad plastic volumes, while B is a flat, pale, thin slab covered in shallow, fine, rectilinear low-relief detail that reads almost as a drawing.
